security_audit.summary: The static command-execution detections are false positives caused by fenced path lists, inline markdown, and Grep or Glob search examples. No shell execution, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent was found. A medium semantic risk remains because the skill directs agents to inspect hardcoded absolute paths outside the skill package.

remediation.issue: Hardcoded absolute repository paths point outside the skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Use relative paths within bundled documentation, or ask the user to provide repository locations before reading files.

remediation.issue: The skill does not warn before reading user-local absolute paths.
remediation.suggestion: Add an instruction to confirm with the user before using Read, Grep, or Glob outside the current workspace.

remediation.issue: Markdown fences use command-like formatting for search examples.
remediation.suggestion: Label examples as tool queries or plain text to reduce false command-execution detections.

content.value_statement: ANcpLua users need quick answers across SDK, analyzer, and Roslyn utility docs. This skill maps topics to the right files and search patterns for precise documentation responses.
actual_capabilities: Routes questions to ANcpLua.NET.Sdk, ANcpLua.Analyzers, or ANcpLua.Roslyn.Utilities documentation.
Identifies quick reference files such as README, CLAUDE, docs index, and analyzer rule pages.
Suggests Grep and Glob search patterns for analyzer rules, SDK features, and utility APIs.
Formats answers with a direct response, source path, relevant content, and related documentation.
Cross-references shared concepts across SDK, analyzer, and utility repositories.
limitations: It depends on the referenced ANcpLua repositories and docs being available locally.
It does not run builds, tests, package commands, or repository modifications.
It covers ANcpLua ecosystem docs only, not general .NET or Roslyn support.
Hardcoded local paths may need adjustment on other machines.

use_cases.title: Explore Analyzer Rules
use_cases.description: Find rule documentation for AL0001 through AL0017 and related code fix guidance.

use_cases.title: Locate SDK Configuration
use_cases.description: Identify docs for MSBuild properties, SDK variants, banned APIs, tests, and polyfills.

use_cases.title: Research Roslyn Helper APIs
use_cases.description: Find docs for DiagnosticFlow, SemanticGuard, SymbolPattern, and provider pipeline helpers.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ancplua-docs to find where the documentation explains ANcpLua SDK variants. Include related files.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ancplua-docs to explain how DiagnosticFlow is documented. Cite the source file path and related utility docs.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Areas
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ancplua-docs to compare SDK banned API guidance with analyzer rule documentation. Point me to the relevant docs.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Cross-Repo Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ancplua-docs to answer how an analyzer author should use ANcpLua.Roslyn.Utilities with ANcpLua.Analyzers. Include source paths and caveats.

output_examples.output: A concise answer points to the analyzer docs index, AL0001 through AL0017 rule pages, and the README rules table.
The response directs the user to SDK LegacySupport documentation and names the relevant polyfill topic pages.
The answer cites the utilities SemanticGuard documentation and mentions related pattern matching and pipeline docs.

best_practices: Ask about one ANcpLua topic at a time for focused source paths.
Request source paths when you need traceable documentation answers.
Verify repository locations match your local checkout before using search guidance.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for general .NET questions unrelated to ANcpLua docs.
Do not assume the listed absolute paths exist on every machine.
Do not ask it to run builds, tests, or repository modification commands.

faq.question: What documentation does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers ANcpLua.NET.Sdk, ANcpLua.Analyzers, and ANcpLua.Roslyn.Utilities documentation.

faq.question: Does it execute shell commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill declares Read, Grep, and Glob tools only.

faq.question: Can it answer general Roslyn questions?
faq.answer: It is best for ANcpLua Roslyn utility docs, not broad Roslyn API support.

faq.question: Can I use it if my repositories are in different folders?
faq.answer: Yes, but update paths or provide your local repository locations first.

faq.question: What answer format should I expect?
faq.answer: It gives a direct answer, cites the source path, and lists related documentation.

faq.question: Is it useful for analyzer rule discovery?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps AL0001 through AL0017 to rule documentation and README references.
